import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow.keras.models import Sequential
from tensorflow.keras import layers
from matplotlib import pyplot as plt

# --- [CELL 5]: ---

train_ds = tf.keras.utils.image_dataset_from_directory(
    data_dir,
    validation_split=0.2,
    subset='training',
    image_size=(image_height, image_width),
    seed = 1,
    shuffle=True,
    batch_size=batch_size
)

# --- [CELL 6]: ---

val_ds = tf.keras.utils.image_dataset_from_directory(
    data_dir,
    validation_split=0.2,
    subset='validation',
    image_size=(image_height, image_width),
    seed = 1,
    shuffle=True,
    batch_size=batch_size
)

# --- [CELL 8]: ---

from tensorflow import keras
data_augmentation = keras.Sequential(
  [
    layers.RandomFlip("horizontal",
                      input_shape=(image_height,
                                  image_width,
                                  3)),
    layers.RandomRotation(0.1),
    layers.RandomZoom(0.1),
  ]
)

# --- [CELL 10]: ---

model = Sequential([
  data_augmentation,
  normalization_layer,
  layers.Conv2D(16, 3, padding='same', activation='relu'),
  layers.MaxPooling2D(),
  layers.Conv2D(32, 3, padding='same', activation='relu'),
  layers.MaxPooling2D(),
  layers.Conv2D(64, 3, padding='same', activation='relu'),
  layers.MaxPooling2D(),
  layers.Dropout(0.2),
  layers.Flatten(),
  layers.Dense(128, activation='relu'),
  layers.Dense(num_of_classes, name="outputs")
])

valid_exts = {'.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png', '.bmp', '.gif'}

all_files = [p for c in class_dirs for p in c.iterdir() if p.is_file()]
valid_files = [p for p in all_files if p.suffix.lower() in valid_exts]

if len(valid_files) != len(all_files):
    print(f"Skipping {len(all_files) - len(valid_files)} non-image/invalid-extension files")
